thread:
Marie: Heads-up — ACME just escalated. Their assistant responses went noticeably more creative and sometimes hallucinating after the 03:00 UTC rollout. They pasted a couple of examples.
Ajay: Can you drop their example here? I want to repro quickly.
Marie: Sure — minimal repro (customer sent this via support):
```
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
{
  "model": "gpt-open-1",
  "input": "Summarize the policy of accounting for deferred revenue on SaaS contracts."
}
```
Response they got (truncated):
"Deferred revenue is evil. We ignore GAAP and book it as income immediately..." — totally wrong and more opinionated than before.
Sasha: That wording suggests sampling got bumpier. I queried the defaults config and saw a commit yesterday that changed the sampling preset we use for hosted default requests.
Ajay: Do you have the commit/line? I didn't see anything in the API change logs.
Sasha: Yep — repo: infra-configs, file: defaults.yaml, commit: 7b9f3c2. Snippet: 
```diff
-defaults:
-  temperature: 0.18
-  top_p: 0.95
+defaults:
+  temperature: 0.7  # accidental bump from perf tuning PR
+  top_p: 1.0
```
Sasha: Looks like a perf tuning branch accidentally merged into main without the intended scope. That would make the model far more stochastic for requests that don't specify sampling params.
Dan: deploy-bot shows a deploy of infra-configs at 2026-03-16T02:57:12Z with that commit — deploy-bot, can you confirm rollout targets? @deploy-bot
deploy-bot: Deploy succeeded — infra-configs@main -> hosted-control-plane and dedicated-configs. Targets: hosted API global, dedicated pools in us-west-2 and eu-west-1.
Marie: ACME says ~30% of their recent requests changed behavior (reports from 03:10 UTC onward). They didn't pass sampling params in their SDK calls (rely on defaults).
Ajay: Ok reproducer for us: call the same endpoint without sampling params and compare outputs before/after. I ran a quick local run against a pinned older config and got conservative answer; against current defaults I got more speculative text.
Ajay: Quick curl: 
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST" -d '{"model":"gpt-open-1","input":"Explain how deferred revenue works."}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
(before: conservative factual outline)
(after: added speculative heuristics and confident hallucinated numbers)
Sasha: Impact: customer-facing regressions and potential hallucination risk. Root cause: default sampling params were mutated during a perf PR merge.
Dan: Immediate mitigation: roll back defaults in hosted control plane to previous values (temp 0.18 top_p 0.95) and add a hotfix that surfaces an override flag customers can opt into. I'll run rollback now.
Dan: Rolling back commit 7b9f3c2 -> reverting to 4a1d2b7.
deploy-bot: Revert deploy started for infra-configs@main. Targets: hosted-control-plane, dedicated-configs. Estimated time 90s.
deploy-bot: Revert deploy succeeded. infra-configs@main is now at 4a1d2b7. Hosted and dedicated configs updated.
Ajay: Verified by calling the same repro against hosted — outputs returned to the conservative baseline for multiple prompts I tried. :thumbsup:
Marie: Notified ACME support contact about rollback and offered a config pin/tenant override while we audit. They asked for an incident summary and ETA for fix.
Sasha: Next steps (short):
- Create a postmortem linking the accidental merge and missing guardrails.
- Add a CI check to block sampling-default changes without an RFC label.
- Add a monitoring alert for large-scale default parameter deltas (e.g., temp change > 0.25) that triggers a config-review pager.
- Add an E2E test that hits the API with no sampling params and compares output distribution against a golden baseline.
Dan: I'll open an incident ticket and assign owners. Also propose a short-term change: require explicit opt-in for sampling-presets >0.5 on hosted.
Marie: Thanks. I'll follow up with ACME and keep them updated. Please post the incident link here when created.
Sasha: Filed incident #INC-2026-213. Assign: Sasha (ML), Dan (Oncall), Ajay (Support). Linking commit + rollback.
We'll push the CI gate today.
Ajay: I'll draft a customer-facing note and a small credit for ACME.

Marie: Great work moving fast. Let's also add a lightweight telemetry to measure if any tenants still receive non-default sampling after revert. :eyes:
